caption: The drawing features a cylindrical stoneware vessel with a slightly flared rim and two small loop handles on opposite sides near the top. The vessel is depicted in tones of light brown with areas of shading to indicate curvature and depth. There is a decorative band with a circular motif near the upper section. On the front surface of the vessel, there is a blue illustration showing a standing human figure dressed in a cloak and wide-brimmed hat, holding a long staff or cane. This figure is framed by a simple landscape that includes stylized trees and possibly ground lines. Additional small blue motifs are visible to the left and right sides of the illustration. The entire vessel sits on a flat, plain background.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
